name: Gladiator I-class Star Destroyer
description: The Gladiator I-class Star Destroyer was the first sub-class of the Gladiator-class line of Star Destroyers used by the Galactic Empire after the Clone Wars and during the Galactic Civil War. It was succeeded by the Gladiator II-class Star Destroyer.

data.name: Gladiator I-class Star Destroyer
armament: Torpedo or medium concussion missile launcher batteries (2)
